data.hook: Maxx Crosby drew a firm line: he wanted to stay a Raider. Now, months after a potential trade fell apart, he's set to suit up for Las Vegas on Sunday.
data.name: Maxx Crosby Stays with Raiders After Trade Drama Ends
data.summary: The five-time Pro Bowler shut down trade interest from teams like the Rams, Eagles, Cowboys, and 49ers following a collapsed deal to the Ravens in March due to medical concerns. Raiders fans are relieved their star edge rusher will anchor the defense in the home opener against the Miami Dolphins, while some Cowboys supporters lament the missed chance.

data.hook: Ashton Jeanty powered through for 102 rushing yards and two receiving touchdowns, giving the Raiders the edge they needed to hold off Miami.
data.name: Raiders Top Dolphins 27-13 in Season-Opening Win at Home
data.summary: The Las Vegas Raiders started their 2026 season strong, beating the Miami Dolphins 27-13 at Allegiant Stadium. New head coach Klint Kubiak earned his first regular-season victory, with quarterback Kirk Cousins throwing three touchdowns in his Raiders debut, including one to rookie Jack Bech. Jeanty's 147 total yards fueled the offense, while the defense sacked Miami's Malik Willis five times and controlled the clock for nearly 35 minutes. Fans celebrated the promising start as both teams head into Week 2 at 1-0 or 0-1.

data.hook: Tucker Kraft, the 25-year-old tight end coming off an ACL tear, just got the biggest vote of confidence from Green Bay: a massive four-year deal that crowns him the NFL's top-paid at his position.
data.name: Packers Lock In Tucker Kraft with $75M Extension Through 2030
data.summary: The Packers extended Kraft for four years at $75 million, with potential up to $92 million including a $26.5 million signing bonus, securing the 2023 third-round pick through 2030. Despite his 2025 season cut short by injury after 32 catches, 489 yards, and six touchdowns, his first three NFL years put him in elite company with Rob Gronkowski and Mark Andrews. Fans and analysts mostly cheered the move as a smart commitment to a rising star, though some flagged his injury history amid the team-friendly structure. Kraft is set to play fully when Green Bay faces the Vikings on Sunday.
